item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Yusuf's circuit. Two cells are joined end to end, and wires connect them to a small lamp. The + end of one cell touches the − end of the other cell. The lamp lights.

Which claim about the cells is correct?

options.A: The two cells make a working battery because the + end of one cell touches the + end of the other cell.
options.B: Only one cell is shown, so this cannot be a battery made of two or more cells.
options.C: The two cells make a working battery because opposite terminals touch and together they can run the lamp.
options.D: Any two cells always make a working battery, even if no terminals touch.
